svg.aria-label: Sentinel AI architecture: the public brief, the sign-in, the desk, the FastAPI review pipeline and the Postgres record
svg.text: Architecture — the door, the desk, the review pipeline, the record
Every arrow is a real call; nothing here is aspirational.
public link → brief → sign-in → desk · lib/routes.ts is the only route list
no session, or an expired token → the brief — and the room you asked for is remembered, once
Next.js 14 App Router · React 18 · Tailwind · self-hosted fonts · no third-party requests at runtime
gate · remembers the room · never skips /login
one fetch wrapper · Bearer JWT · 401 handling
day / night shift · characters on or off
ticks a room only once it was opened
the chrome · last reader of the route list
next.config rewrites → API_URL · the API origin never reaches the browser
FastAPI · Python 3.12 · REST/JSON under /v1 · every request scoped to one organisation
JWT → Principal(org_id, role) → per-endpoint permission → set_request_org() for RLS · foreign objects answer 404, never 403
Postgres in any shared environment · SQLite is local/demo only
keys live in the API environment, never the browser
what survives a restart: the database, the storage, and — when you choose one — the model
local disk in dev, S3 when shared
originals served back to the report
falls back to the local engine
on a limit, an error or no key
THE CHANGE LEDGER — the one flow that explains the product
uploaded once, as a document — the version everything was judged against
sections matched by title, then difflib ratio; a rename is never asserted
A11Y-001..003 and LEG-001..003, every one needs_review, every rule still active
keep / edit / retire — and nothing has changed until that returns
nothing publishes · nothing auto-fixes · no rule changes without a manager's click
keys via environment variables only · never in the browser
